title: Snowflake with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- Snowflake with smiling face, bright icy colors -->
  <!-- Six arms at 60-degree intervals, each with branches -->
  <!-- Use light cyan/white for main structure, darker blue for details -->

  <!-- Main vertical arm -->
  <rect x='47' y='10' width='6' height='80' rx='2' fill='#e8f8ff'/>
  <!-- Main horizontal arm -->
  <rect x='10' y='47' width='80' height='6' rx='2' fill='#e8f8ff'/>
  <!-- Diagonal arm top-left to bottom-right -->
  <rect x='47' y='10' width='6' height='80' rx='2' fill='#e8f8ff' transform='rotate(60 50 50)'/>
  <!-- Diagonal arm top-right to bottom-left -->
  <rect x='47' y='10' width='6' height='80' rx='2' fill='#e8f8ff' transform='rotate(-60 50 50)'/>

  <!-- Branches on vertical arm (top) -->
  <rect x='33' y='20' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(-30 50 22)'/>
  <rect x='33' y='20' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(30 50 22)'/>
  <!-- Branches on vertical arm (bottom) -->
  <rect x='33' y='75' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(-30 50 78)'/>
  <rect x='33' y='75' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(30 50 78)'/>

  <!-- Branches on horizontal arm (left) -->
  <rect x='20' y='33' width='5' height='34' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(-30 22 50)'/>
  <rect x='20' y='33' width='5' height='34' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(30 22 50)'/>
  <!-- Branches on horizontal arm (right) -->
  <rect x='75' y='33' width='5' height='34' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(-30 78 50)'/>
  <rect x='75' y='33' width='5' height='34' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(30 78 50)'/>

  <!-- Diagonal arm branches (rotated group) -->
  <g transform='rotate(60 50 50)'>
    <rect x='33' y='20' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(-30 50 22)'/>
    <rect x='33' y='20' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(30 50 22)'/>
    <rect x='33' y='75' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(-30 50 78)'/>
    <rect x='33' y='75' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(30 50 78)'/>
  </g>
  <g transform='rotate(-60 50 50)'>
    <rect x='33' y='20' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(-30 50 22)'/>
    <rect x='33' y='20' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(30 50 22)'/>
    <rect x='33' y='75' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(-30 50 78)'/>
    <rect x='33' y='75' width='34' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b8e8ff' transform='rotate(30 50 78)'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Center hexagonal body / face area -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='18' fill='#d0f0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='16' fill='#e8f8ff'/>

  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='46' r='3' fill='#4090c0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='3' fill='#4090c0'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='45' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M 41 54 Q 50 64 59 54' stroke='#4090c0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='53' r='3' fill='#90c8e8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='53' r='3' fill='#90c8e8' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Small sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='15' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='15' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='70' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='70' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
